stories.headline: Selaco's free Machines of War chapter arrives November 13 with 19 maps
stories.summary: Altered Orbit Studios will release [Selaco](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592280/)'s free Chapter 2 on November 13, adding 19 campaign maps and an estimated six to eight hours of content. Its update also rebuilds enemy AI, adds heavy weapons and revises Chapter 1. Existing saves will be incompatible, but players can jump directly into the new chapter.

stories.headline: Modders plan to restore Mass Effect Legendary Edition multiplayer on November 7
stories.summary: The ME3Tweaks team plans to bring the missing multiplayer mode to [Mass Effect Legendary Edition](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1328670/) on N7 Day, November 7. The community project promises remastered visuals, controller and HDR support, networking upgrades, additional modes and private-server options. It is a fan-made mod, not an official BioWare update.

stories.headline: GRAVHOUNDS targets November 2 Steam Early Access launch
stories.summary: [GRAVHOUNDS](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440760/) is scheduled to enter Steam Early Access on November 2. The cooperative action builder supports one to four players who explore hostile planets, gather resources, construct defenses and attempt to extract safely. The Steam listing still marked it as coming soon when checked, so the launch should not be treated as completed.

stories.headline: Chronicles: Medieval's planned Early Access release faces funding crisis
stories.summary: Raw Power Games says funding for [Chronicles: Medieval](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231020/) has been withdrawn, placing the studio at risk of closing even as its open-world medieval sandbox nears Early Access. The Steam listing still targets 2027. The project has not been confirmed canceled, but its future is uncertain while the team seeks a way forward.

stories.headline: itch.io says daily new game pages doubled without matching player growth
stories.summary: Indie PC storefront [itch.io](https://itch.io/) reports that new project pages per day have doubled over the past two months, while downloads and purchases have not doubled. AI-generated projects may be contributing, but the precise cause is unconfirmed. The discrepancy raises concerns about game discoverability for independent developers.

stories.headline: Melvor Idle 2 becomes an official RuneScape adventure ahead of November 17 launch
stories.summary: Jagex and Games by Malcs have made [Melvor Idle 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3218350/) an officially branded RuneScape spinoff, now subtitled A RuneScape Adventure. Steam lists November 17 for Early Access. The follow-up expands idle skill progression and quests, with the developers saying it will have no microtransactions.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, included with subscription
stories.summary: Blizzard confirms [World of Warcraft: Forever](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301508/pre-purchase-world-of-warcraft-forever-upgrades-and-begin-your-next-journey-in-azeroth) launches globally on November 4 at 3 p.m. PST, included with existing World of Warcraft subscription or game time. This reimagined original-Azeroth experience is distributed through Battle.net; no Steam store page exists.

stories.headline: Soulframe opens its alpha to everyone on November 6
stories.summary: Digital Extremes says its fantasy action RPG will end invite-only testing on November 6. A larger November update, Verse of the Veilands, will overhaul the opening experience, add a corruption-cleansing progression loop and let players raise a wolf mount. Its Steam page is available for wishlisting, but the game is not yet released there.

stories.headline: Dune: Awakening reveals free Blood and Ice expansion for December 1
stories.summary: Funcom's free December 1 expansion adds the Polar Sink, a frozen survival map with tundra and ice-cap biomes, new gear and roughly 35 hours of progression. Offline single-player is also planned for November, with character transfers and full cross-play targeted for January 2027. The additions substantially expand the PC survival game's options.

stories.headline: Alien: Isolation's OpenCAGE modding toolkit reaches version 1.0
stories.summary: Matt Filer's free OpenCAGE toolkit has reached 1.0 after years of development. It now supports extensive custom maps, missions, characters, weapons, animations and other assets, enabling much larger PC mods and total conversions. OpenCAGE is also available on Steam; [click here](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367530/) to view it. Alien: Isolation is required.

stories.headline: FromSoftware temporarily disables Dark Souls II and III online features
stories.summary: FromSoftware has suspended official multiplayer services for Dark Souls II and III across platforms due to an unspecified server issue, with no restoration date announced. The outage affects co-op, invasions and online messages, making it important for PC players planning multiplayer sessions. To visit the Dark Souls II Steam page, [click here](https://store.steampowered.com/app/335300/).

stories.headline: A New Beginning: Final Cut is free to keep on GOG until November 2
stories.summary: GOG is giving away Daedalic Entertainment's science-fiction point-and-click adventure until November 2. Claiming it during the promotion adds the DRM-free PC game permanently to your library. The giveaway is separate from the paid Steam edition and is worth checking before the deadline.

stories.headline: Mina the Hollower developers outline randomizer and speedrun features
stories.summary: Yacht Club Games has discussed upcoming randomizer and speedrunning options for its gothic action-adventure following a successful launch. Release dates for these features have not been announced, but they should give PC players more replay and challenge options.

stories.headline: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold dated for February 23, 2027; Zephyr job revealed
stories.summary: At the Tokyo Fan Festival on October 31, Square Enix confirmed that Final Fantasy XIV's Evercold expansion launches February 23, 2027, later than its previous January window, with early access planned for February 19 and pre-orders opening November 4. The new Zephyr ranged-DPS job combines a crossbow with an avian companion; the keynote also detailed new raid challenges, the Fierce difficulty tier and seasonal rewards.

stories.headline: WORLD OF HORROR gets its largest free update, AS BELOW SO ABOVE
stories.summary: The 1.2 update is now available on PC via Steam, GOG and itch.io. Publisher Ysbryd Games says it expands the cosmic-horror RPG by roughly 20%, with new Old Gods, three playable characters, additional mysteries and a Scenario Mode. Expanded modding tools add more replay possibilities, making this a substantial free return for existing PC players.

stories.headline: Cronos: Lazarus DLC confirmed for December 3 on PC
stories.summary: Bloober Team has dated its survival-horror expansion for December 3, 2026. The prequel follows the Pathfinder on the road to becoming the Warden, with more aggressive combat and a relentless pursuer called the Tracker. It is a substantial new story chapter for Cronos: The New Dawn owners and already has a verified Steam DLC page.

stories.headline: The Wolf Among Us Remastered arrives on PC with Noir Mode
stories.summary: Telltale's remaster launched on Steam on October 29, restoring all five episodes with enhanced visuals, a black-and-white Noir Mode, playable deleted scenes and behind-the-scenes extras. A 20% Steam launch offer runs through November 12, while eligible owners of the original qualify for a larger 50% discount. It is a timely entry point to Bigby Wolf's detective story.

stories.headline: Goblin Cleanup opens a pirate dungeon and launches new Twitch Drops
stories.summary: The Pirate Bay update adds the first two Black Bay dungeon levels to the co-op cleaning sim, alongside firing cannons, new traps, cosmetics, leaderboards and accessibility options. A new six-item Twitch Drops campaign began October 30 and runs through November 25. It is the game's first new dungeon since entering Steam Early Access.

stories.headline: 1992 PC-98 horror adventure Dead of the Brain returns on Steam
stories.summary: The Japanese point-and-click zombie horror game originally released in 1992 is now available on modern PCs through Steam. Publisher FAKKU's rerelease retains the pixel-art presentation and combines investigation, visual-novel storytelling and quick-time events, with optional quality-of-life aids and a demo. It preserves a cult PC horror title for a new audience.

stories.headline: Fatal Claw adds free difficulty options, Speedrun Mode and 10 skills
stories.summary: NDEV GAMES has released a free content update for its 2D Metroidvania, introducing Explorer, Warrior and Trial difficulties, configurable adventure settings, ten Fusion Skills, Speedrun Mode and a new outfit. Boss balancing and progression improvements make the update especially useful for both newcomers and returning players.

stories.headline: Assassin's Creed Valhalla gets New Game+ on November 5
stories.summary: Ubisoft confirmed a November 5 New Game+ update for Assassin's Creed Valhalla. Players can restart Eivor's adventure while carrying over much of their gear and progression, with dedicated scaling, new runes, a stash system, Mithril upgrades and new rewards. The long-requested feature gives PC players a fresh reason to revisit the RPG.

stories.headline: Activision to remove real tragedy footage from Modern Warfare 4
stories.summary: Activision apologized after footage from the 2022 Itaewon crowd crush was identified in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's opening montage. The publisher says the material will be removed in a game update scheduled for November 12, responding to objections from victims' families. The change will affect the PC version's introduction.

stories.headline: Stardeus v0.15 overhauls combat, quests and colony management
stories.summary: The October 29 update delivers more than 1,500 changes, including quests, faction diplomacy, a Rogue AI progression path, redesigned ship and ground combat, and a rebuilt interface. Saves from v0.14 are incompatible, but the developer provides a legacy branch for finishing older runs.

stories.headline: Sorry We're Closed is free to keep on the Epic Games Store
stories.summary: Epic is offering the base edition of the surreal survival-horror adventure for free from October 29 until November 5 at 16:00 UTC. Claiming it during the promotion adds a permanent Epic library license; the offer is separate from the paid Steam version.

stories.headline: Phantom Blade Zero launches with PC performance patch and Nvidia driver warning
stories.summary: S-GAME's martial-arts action RPG is available on Steam. Its approximately 5 GB day-one patch targets ray-tracing and path-tracing performance, while the studio warns that Nvidia driver 621.01 may be unstable and recommends 617.42 until a newer fix arrives. This is important setup information for PC players.

stories.headline: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown adds ocean exploration
stories.summary: Pearl Abyss released the Charting the Unknown expansion on October 29. The paid DLC introduces shipbuilding, islands and underwater exploration, new stories for Kliff, Oongka and Damiane, plus expanded housing and business management. The base game is required.

stories.headline: Age of Empires IV expansion adds Vikings and Scots
stories.summary: Raiders of the North launched on October 29, adding two playable civilizations, Scottish Heathland and Tundra Summer biomes, and four Crucible missions. The Crucible mode now supports two-player co-op, giving strategy players new challenges beyond the civilizations themselves.

stories.headline: Planet Coaster 2 adds buildable walkthrough attractions
stories.summary: The Spooktacular Pack released October 29 with customizable walkthrough attractions, seven rides and more than 700 Halloween scenery pieces. The accompanying free Update 12 adds reaction points and new guest responses, expanding park storytelling even for players without the DLC.

stories.headline: Cairn receives free Deep Water climbing DLC
stories.summary: On the Trail: Deep Water launched October 29 as a free add-on for Cairn owners. It introduces three climbing locations, including cliffs above water and a climbing gym, plus the option to climb as Aava or Marco. Free-roam exploration expands the ways to revisit Mount Kami.

stories.headline: ATMOSFAR launches into Steam Early Access
stories.summary: Shueisha Games and Apog Labs launched ATMOSFAR in Early Access on October 29. The survival-crafting adventure supports solo play and online co-op across floating islands, with flyable Wasp vehicles and a customizable Cloud Cruiser airship base. The developers expect at least nine months in Early Access.

stories.headline: Queen's Domain launches on Steam
stories.summary: The retro-fantasy first-person action RPG launched on October 30 and is now purchasable on Steam, replacing its earlier upcoming-release listing. Players explore the interconnected Isle of Neasied through stamina-based combat, weapon discovery and magical-sword traversal. A free demo remains available.

stories.headline: Monster Train 2 announces The Punished clan DLC for November 10
stories.summary: Shiny Shoe revealed The Punished, a new playable clan led by Archus, for release on November 10. Its mechanics reward deliberately damaging allied units and sacrificing cards to the Monolith for Devotion and Zeal bonuses, offering new risk-reward deckbuilding strategies.

stories.headline: Hexologic is free to keep on Steam until October 31
stories.summary: MythicOwl's hex-grid logic puzzler is 100% discounted on Steam until October 31 at 10:00 Pacific time. Claiming it during the promotion adds the complete game permanently to your account. The well-reviewed puzzle game also includes a level editor and Steam Workshop support.
